# Know when your cron jobs silently stop

> Know when a cron job silently stops. Paste your crontab to get next runs, the right grace period and a wrapped line that pings a heartbeat monitor you can self-host with zero dependencies. Free, open source, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
